answer: Proof of Stake protocols achieve Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral, effectively creating a deep economic ocean of value that secures the network. Like a karst landscape carved by persistent environmental forces, the protocol erodes the profitability of malicious actors. An attacker facing a gale of slashing penalties must invest prohibitive resources to acquire enough stake to compromise consensus, ensuring that identity forgery remains computationally and financially irrational.
